name: Tsundere Makai Princess Arisa to Haramase Shinkon Seikatsu! ~Zenbu Dasu made Nuicha Dame! Zettai Jusei Sasenasai yo ne!~
original_name: ツンデレ魔界プリンセス・アリサと孕ませ新婚生活！～全部出すまで抜いちゃダメ！ぜったい受精させなさいよね！～
source:
Souta is erotic. There live three girls next to his house and he knows all of them well. His parents are now abroad on business, so he is taken care of them. On Arisa's birthday, they tell him that they are daughters of the Devil. Souta isn't surprised to hear that. They are relieved and tell him why they live in this world. Their purpose is to find a partner and prevent extinction. They suddenly order him to choose a partner out of them....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090208170331/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012044]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
苏太是色情的。他家旁边住着三个女孩，他对她们都很熟悉。他的父母现在在国外出差，所以他受到照顾。在亚里沙生日那天，她们告诉他她们是魔鬼的女儿。苏太听到这个消息并不感到惊讶。他们松了口气，并告诉他自己为什么活在这个世界上。他们的目的是寻找合作伙伴并防止灭绝。他们突然命令他从他们中选择一个伙伴……
